supported_claims: ASR evaluation reports normalized WER by consultation, reference role, explicit noise condition and reference uncertainty.
Explicitly labeled clinical terms receive occurrence recall/error counts, with labeled versus unlabeled case coverage reported.
Failed cases remain in subgroup denominators and are treated as empty hypotheses.
limitations: Clinical-term scoring is available only where the manifest explicitly supplies clinical_terms; current general datasets may have zero coverage.
No independent annotation or clinical validity is established.
